correctness.rationale: Write m=d-1, h(t)=t(t+1)^d+1 and G(c)=h(c^m). Its derivative h'=(t+1)^(d-1)((d+1)t+1), and h(-1)=1, h(-1/(d+1))=1-d^d/(d+1)^(d+1). Evaluating resultants at these derivative factors gives Res(h,h')=R=(d+1)^(d+1)-d^d. Composition product over m-th roots gives Res(G,h'(c^m))=R^m and Res(G,m c^(m-1))=m^N(-1)^(N(m-1)) for N=d^2-1; multiplying and the discriminant sign (-1)^(N(N-1)/2) simplify to (-1)^(d+1). R positive for d>=2, so polynomial discriminant nonzero and exact v_p formula follows. Independent exact small-d discriminants confirm sign and powers. This is not a number-field discriminant or a higher-period result.
